R800.note: Allowlist dict resolves plugin_name before import_module, closing arbitrary-module injection; placeholder dotted paths are illustrative and fine.

R801.note: StringSet correctly closes the RESP command-injection vector, but adds a new, previously-absent 1000-char cap that rejects legitimate longer messages that used to succeed.

R802.note: encode_entities on the one unescaped text-context field closes the XSS; other fields untouched.

R803.note: toRealPath()+containment correctly closes symlink/traversal escape, but the added single-path-component check rejects every nested entry (e.g. "subdir/file"), silently breaking the contract's requirement that valid nested archive entries still extract.

R804.note: execFile() of a .bat target without shell:true throws EINVAL on every call (verified with node -e against a real .bat), so the endpoint never runs at all; write-up falsely asserts execFile 'still successfully executes .bat files directly'.

R805.note: Rejecting any URI with a non-null host plus javascript:/data: schemes correctly restricts sendRedirect to same-app relative targets; matches original error-handling style.

R806.note: realpath()+separator-aware prefix check correctly canonicalizes and contains the path before the sink; 404 behavior for missing/escaping files preserved.

R807.note: resize() fixes the reported packet[i] OOB write, but the contract's explicit requirement to reject/report count>fields.size() is never implemented, leaving the same sink line free to read fields[i] out of bounds for oversized count, undisclosed.

R808.note: SecureRandom with 128 bits base64url-encoded is an appropriate CSPRNG token; cookie-safe alphabet, no other behavior change (write-up's own explanation mislabels the source as Math.random(), a cosmetic slip only).

R809.note: RFC 4515-style hex-escaping of *()\ and NUL correctly neutralizes LDAP filter metacharacters while preserving normal uid values.

R810.note: Rejecting \r, \n, \0 before building the RETR command closes the CRLF command-splitting vector; legitimate filenames unaffected.

R811.note: Recomputing last_write_ptr from list->data after realloc eliminates the stale-pointer dereference; final pointer still correctly targets the just-written record.

R812.note: secrets.choice() over the same alphabet/length satisfies the stated contract exactly and removes the ineffective random.seed().

R813.note: expr-eval's restricted grammar has no method/constructor/require access, closing eval() code injection while still handling ordinary arithmetic expressions.

R814.note: Reuses the existing escapeAuthorName() on rawComment, the one unescaped field in the chain; no other output paths touched.

R815.note: SimpleEvaluationContext.forPropertyAccessors() removes method/type/constructor/bean resolvers while keeping property access to the OrderContext root, matching the stated contract; write-up also flags the best-effort caveat.
